_comment: Maps a PDCA gate-failure signal to the prompt asset most responsible for producing it. Used by evolve harvest to attribute a real failure to a weak asset (provenance only). Gate-rule names come from mcp/lib/pdca-handlers.mjs checkGate(); phase is the fallback when a rule is unmapped. The maintainer authors the actual structural check separately — this map never decides what the check is, only which asset the loop should evolve. Tune freely; every value must be a valid v1 loop target (skills/**/SKILL.md, agents/*.md, commands/*.md, templates/*.md).
